title: Mia and Leo
text:
Mia gets pocket money from her dad every Friday. She gets ten dollars every month. She likes to buy small things for her room. Last week she bought a new pen and a notebook.

Mia's brother Leo gets less money, but he saves it. He wants to buy a football. The football costs twenty dollars, so he needs two months to save. On Sunday, Mia helps him count his coins.

questions.text: How often does Mia get pocket money?
What does Leo want to buy?
Why does Leo need two months to save for the football?
options: The football costs more than he can save in one month
His dad does not give him any money
He wants to buy a notebook first

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Mia?
options: She is kind and helps her brother
She does not like her brother
She never buys things for herself

vocabulary.definition: keeps money for later instead of spending it
a large round ball used in a sport played with the feet
does something to make another person's task easier

paragraph_translations: Mia her Cuma babasından harçlık alır. Her ay on dolar alır. Odasına küçük şeyler almayı sever. Geçen hafta yeni bir kalem ve bir defter aldı.

Mia'nın kardeşi Leo daha az para alır, ama onu biriktirir. Bir futbol topu almak istiyor. Futbol topu yirmi dolar tutuyor, bu yüzden biriktirmek için iki aya ihtiyacı var. Pazar günü Mia, madeni paralarını saymasına yardım eder.
